title: Theme of Inevitable Aging and Separation in My Mother at Sixty-six

title: Satire and Irony in The Tiger King
bypass: Value Points: 1) Satire: Kalki satires the conceit and arbitrary power of rulers who neglect state duties to satisfy personal whims. 2) Prophecy: Astrologer predicts Maharaja's death by 100th tiger.
